item.title: Melted Pottery PROVES Biblical Catastrophe | Gomorrah
item.description:
Join us as we explore the lost city and its shocking secrets.

The Bible speaks of divine fire, but archaeologists found physical proof of a cosmic impact that incinerated a city in seconds. What really descended from above?

Archaeologists discovered a city destroyed by an unimaginable event. The Bible tells the story of Sodom and Gomorrah, but what physical evidence remains? Explore the scientific findings of melted pottery and cosmic impact that could explain the rapid, absolute destruction of an ancient city, challenging previous assumptions and uncovering a real cosmic event documented by researchers.

item.title: Cosmic void SHOULDN'T hold such a universe. | Hubble
item.description:
Embark on a voyage to the universe's most profound secrets with Hubble.

For decades, humanity believed the cosmos was finite. Then, Hubble stared into absolute darkness, revealing an unimaginable depth of space.

A silver cylinder the size of a school bus, orbiting 540 kilometers above Earth, has spent decades rewriting our understanding of the universe. The Hubble Space Telescope, by staring into what seemed like absolute nothingness, unveiled an unimaginable tapestry of galaxies and cosmic structures. Its profound discoveries challenged established theories on the cosmos's age and scale, leaving us with thrilling scientific mysteries about the true nature of space and time.

⏱️ Chapters
00:00 Pointing the most sensitive optical instrument
01:15 Sparse light traversing the dark abyss
02:45 First objects observed: ground-based telescopes
04:09 Digital photograph formed by photons
05:27 Space growth tested by observing
06:46 Precision data filled space agency hard drives
